name: Poste de lanterna
prompt: Image1 is a strict top-down GEOMETRIC PLAN GUIDE. Image2 is MATERIAL/COLOR reference only, DO NOT repeat its tilted camera. Image3 supplies approved hand-painted medieval battlemap style. Create one original richly textured isolated sprite following the exact overhead geometry of image1. Medieval street lantern on a post viewed from ABSOLUTE ZENITH. Show ONLY a square pyramidal copper ROOF CAP centered exactly above a circular stone base. The roof is concentric with base; no sideways offset. Four triangular copper roof top planes meet at a central small cap. The opaque roof completely hides glass window panes and post shaft. Absolutely no lantern front, window face or upright shaft. Footprint ratio 1:1. Camera truly vertical at 90 degrees, no perspective or elevation. Warm worn detailed natural material, restrained contour, even overhead light. Genuinely transparent alpha outside complete object. No extra furniture, terrain, text, grid, watermark, people or shadow halo.
